vulnerabilities.description: User-controlled arguments are joined into a shell command without proper escaping. The pattern newArgs.join(' ') can be exploited with shell metacharacters (;, |, &&, $(), etc.).
vulnerabilities.risk: Remote Code Execution (RCE) on the developer's machine
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Use execFileSync instead of execSync; use array arguments instead of string interpolation
